findings.message: 3 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Describe a business. Get the company that runs i" → 3 lines (9 words, 68px); "From idea to operating organisation. In three st" → 3 lines (8 words, 50px); "What is an Autonomous Organisation?" → 3 lines (5 words, 50px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 11 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Build your first mobile app on us" (pill) above "Describe a business. Get the company tha"; "Start with a sentence" above "You don't need a team to start. You need"; "6 departments · 1 organisation" (pill) above "A full company, staffed by AI. Working e"; "Know more about us" above "What is an Autonomous Organisation?"; "Simple plans" above "Choose how much it does without you."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: Geist Mono — e.g. "M", "[ PROMPT ]", "[ ORGANISATION ]", "[ PEOPLE ]"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "STEP 01", "STEP 02", "STEP 03", "03"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 89 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "[ PROMPT ]", "[ ORGANISATION ]", "[ PEOPLE ]", "[ BUSINESSES ]").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✓
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 3 gradient fill(s): div.cell → radial-gradient(70% 90% at 50% 40%, rgb(42, 128, 246), rgb(21, 102, 224) 70%) | a.video → radial-gradient(70% 80%, rgb(19, 33, 60), rgb(10, 18, 34) 72%) | article.plan.pop → linear-gradient(rgb(234, 243, 255), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 220px)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 21 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.pill → rgb(227, 232, 240) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset, rgba(20, 40, 80, 0.08) 0px 1px 2px 0px | div.prompt → rgb(227, 232, 240) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset, rgba(20, 40, 80, 0.08) 0px 1px 2px 0px | button#modeFull → rgba(20, 40, 80, 0.12) 0px 1px 2px 0px, rgb(227, 232, 240) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 107 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.row.nav 1424px | div.cell 1112px | div.pbar 640px | section.row.stage 1424px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 5 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 3 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "□□□□□□□" 2.2:1 (#a3abba on #f8fafd); "PROMPT" 2.2:1 (#a3abba on #f8fafd); "FIRST CUSTOMER" 2.2:1 (#a3abba on #f8fafd); "□□□□□□" 2.2:1 (#a3abba on #f8fafd)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 15px.
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (4.7:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 89 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 72 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "Describe a business. Get the company that runs i" → 3 lines (9 words, 46.1px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: The margins differ: 45px on the left, 25px on the right, at 768px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 4 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "┌──────┴─────┐" (14px from the right); "│ SALES │" (14px from the right); "│ › sells │" (14px from the right); "└────────────┘" (14px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.
